title: Pseudo-Clementine Homilies / «Климентины: Беседы (Гомилии)»
author: Anonymous (Syrian Jewish-Christian milieu)
edition: Rehm, Irmscher, Paschke, GCS 42 (1953; 3rd ed. 1992). Public domain: Dressel (1853); Lagarde (1865).
ru_evidence: azbyka.ru 'Климент Римский' lists only the Epistles and De virginitate; ru.wikipedia 'Климентины' cites only studies, no translation
en_evidence: Ante-Nicene Fathers vol. 8 (1886), public domain; ru.wikipedia links English versions
other_translations: French: Écrits apocryphes chrétiens II (Pléiade 2005); not verified here
value: The only Christian 'recognition novel' of antiquity, structurally close to the Greek romances. Homilies 4–6 stage Clement against Apion on allegorical readings of myth; also Simon Magus and Jewish Christianity. Relevant to ancient-novel studies (incl. the Alexander Romance) and mythography.
ai_feasibility: high: clear koine narrative and dialogue; public-domain Greek, with English available for checking.
pilot_unit: Homilies 4–6 (debate with Apion on Greek myths); est. 14–16k words
